result:
My part of round 148 (V-0.5c) is done and passes all the checks I'm allowed to run. C's browser rows and the root gate rows have not run yet. Nothing was committed.

**Start checks:** all passed. HEAD was 34ce551 with a clean tree, the 957-file frozen list matched, and the 9 start hashes and copies matched. A baseline probe of the `/studio-lab` server render made 0 `console.error` calls.

**What changed (only the 11 files the task allows, all by Edit/Write; Biome did not re-wrap anything):**
- **`strings.ts`:** new `studioVideoDockStrings` object with the 17 strings from the task table.
- **`ArrangementVideoDock.tsx`:** the 18 Georgian texts now come from that object, plus one import. `git diff` shows only those 19 lines changed.
- **`studio-lab.tsx`:** page title is now `Studio Lab — Demo workspace | CZABA`.
- **Existing tests:**
  - `strings.test.ts`: updated ST40 and ST47, added ST50 and ST51. ST51 walks the Studio folders itself (65 files today, with a guard of at least 60), so a new file with Georgian text gets caught automatically.
  - Pin updates in `floating-video`, `render-budget` and `purchased-collection-ui`.
  - The server-render test now asserts that `console.error` is never called.
- **New test file `video-dock-strings-ui.test.tsx`:** three tests, VDS1–VDS3. VDS3 does run in jsdom, so I didn't need the fallback in the task: a rejected video `play()` shows exactly `Video playback failed — try MP4 (H.264) or WebM.` and stops the transport.
- **Docs:** doc 120 got its two status edits, and new doc 121 is written in Georgian.

**Checks run:**
- **Typecheck, lint, Biome:** `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` exit 0. Biome (read-only) on the 9 code and test files reports nothing.
- **Tests:** the 13 assigned files pass, 215/215 (the baseline was 210). `strings` went from 49 to 51 tests, the new file has 3, and every other file's count is unchanged. I ran the new file 3 more times and it passed every time.
- **Mutations m107–m113:** each one made the expected tests fail. Each was then reverted by Edit and confirmed by hash, and the temporary `zz-rv4-probe.ts` file is deleted.
- **End state:** the frozen list still matches. `git status` shows only the 9 modified and 2 new files. The protected and globally forbidden files are unchanged against 34ce551.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer agent found no Critical, High or Medium issues and four Lows. I fixed two:
- the drag and close buttons are now found by their accessible names;
- doc 121's line numbers are corrected.

I wrote one down:
- VDS3 relies on about 50 ms of real time and on the current order of steps.

One I left as it is:
- jsdom can't check that text is actually visible on screen, so C's browser check covers that.

Its Architecture note goes to B word for word in the report. In short, keep the shared strings file and the folder walk inside `strings.test.ts` for now, and add both to the planned architecture checkpoint.

**Known gaps:**
- I did no browser check; that is C's job.
- The task gave lines 297–298 for the `purchased-collection-ui` assertions, but they are actually on lines 298–299. I edited the intended ones.

Not run by me: the full test suite, `npm run verify`, build and e2e — those are gate rows. I have not marked the backlog or V-0 as complete.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- a-round-148.md
- a-round-148/vitest.json
- a-round-148/vitest-baseline.json
- a-round-148/mutations/
- a-round-148/end-sha256.txt
- a-round-148/diff-vs-start.patch
